page.layout: One printed page: title page inside an ornamental woodcut border. Full-width title block at top, centred; below it a motto, then a short passage with a large decorative initial and marginal-like letters (P, Q, T, V, P) at the left, then a central ornament, the imprint and date at the foot. Handwritten numbers in the top right and below the page are not printed text and are omitted.

main_text.p: In pietate potiùs quam in sede existimanda successio. Nam qui eandem fidei doctrinam profitetur, ejusdem quoque throni particeps est. Qui contrariam fidem amplectitur adversarius quoque in throno censeri debet. Successio fidei proprie successio existimanda est.

page.notes: The large initial letters P, Q, T, V and P at the left of the passage are decorative drop letters forming the start of the words "pietate", "qui", "throni", "versarius", "proprie" and are read as part of that passage. The passage's first letters are set in large type; "In" precedes them. Some letters are blurred by show-through. The woodcut border and central ornament are not text. Handwritten "20" at top right and "20." at the foot are not printed and are omitted.
